title: What the Hessian matrix is
description: Standard math: the Hessian is the square matrix of second-order partial derivatives of a scalar function.

title: Computing the Hessian — worked example
description: Standard math, worked: f(x,y)=x²+xy+y² has Hessian [[2,1],[1,2]], eigenvalues 3 and 1, local minimum at origin.

title: The second-derivative test
description: Standard math: the theorem — determinant sign and f_xx decide minimum, maximum, saddle, or inconclusive.

title: Rosenbrock function Hessian — worked
description: Standard math, worked: the Rosenbrock Hessian at (1,1) is [[802,−400],[−400,200]], det 400, minimum.

title: Three-variable Hessian — worked
description: Standard math, worked: f(x,y,z)=x²+2y²+3z²+xy+yz has positive-definite Hessian, minimum at origin.

title: Hessian in Newton's method
description: Standard math: Newton's optimization step x ← x − H⁻¹∇f — the Hessian sets the step size and direction.

title: Hessian vs. Jacobian
description: Standard math: the Jacobian holds first derivatives of a vector function; the Hessian holds second derivatives of a scalar function.

title: Hessian code that computes
description: Standard math as code: a compact, verified routine computing any 2×2 Hessian by central differences.
